name: B10-0141/2026 (PPE) – World Cancer Day
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is an opinion, not a law. The European Parliament marks World Cancer Day by calling on the European Union and member states to keep funding and running Europe's Beating Cancer Plan after 2027. It asks for a dedicated health budget, better access to cancer treatment across borders, fairer access to medicines, action on cancer in children and older people, and protection for survivors from financial discrimination, including the "right to be forgotten".

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests to the European Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** Cancer patients, survivors, families, health workers and researchers across the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends the text to the Council and Commission; they decide whether to act.
